newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: General Pradzynsk loading 33,500 tonnes soybeans. Great Dove loading 56,700 tonnes soybeans. Great Lake loading 36,000 tonnes soymeal. Kopalnia Szezygla loading 10,500 tonnes soymeal. Slavianka loading 19,400 tonnes soybeans/meal. Waiting to dock, 10 vessels to load soymeal, three to load soybeans and one for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 1,526 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between July 18 and 20, as well as 619 trucks with soymeal and 167 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.

Vessels: At public terminal, Darya loading 30,000 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 12,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, no vessel docked. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 51,000 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 24 trucks carrying 630 tonnes soybeans arrived on July 20.
Rail: 51 wagons arrived carrying 3,169 tonnes soybeans.
